lore.ash_axe.other: The gravekeepers burned their dead twice. Once for mercy, once to be certain.

lore.march_plate.other: Its last wearer held the gate until the bells forgot how to ring.

lore.ember_lens.other: A sliver of sunset, warm long after the sky went dark.

lore.ashcleaver.other: The blade remembers every pyre. Something within it is learning your name.

lore.cinder_edge.other: Drawn through the ashes of a fallen shrine, its edge never cooled.

lore.oath_hammer.other: The verdict outlived the judge. The hammer is still listening.

lore.pilgrim_pike.other: Its owner reached the sanctuary. Only the spear came home.

lore.ash_weave.other: Funeral cloth mended with the threads of a hundred unfinished prayers.

lore.oath_plate.other: Each plate bears a promise. None records whether it was kept.

lore.serath_shroud.other: They wrapped the saint in this to smother the fire. The cloth learned to burn.

lore.stone_seal.other: Pressed into cooling stone when the old oaths still had witnesses.

lore.war_token.other: A handful of battlefield earth, carried farther than its dead ever marched.

lore.starter_head.other: The watchmen listened for a bell that would warn them when dawn failed.

lore.starter_shoulders.other: Mourning cloth folded into armor by hands that had buried enough friends.

lore.starter_chest.other: Patched at every refuge along a road with no promised end.

lore.starter_gloves.other: The pale knuckle guards were carved by someone who knew the weight of a shovel.

lore.starter_belt.other: Every hanging strip names someone whose final prayer went unanswered.

lore.starter_legs.other: Kneel for the dead. Rise for those who still need you.

lore.starter_boots.other: The stitching glows like the road home, remembered through a closing furnace door.

lore.starter_amulet.other: A promise to leave one lantern burning for the last traveler.

lore.starter_ring1.other: Salt for the threshold. Iron for whatever crosses it.

lore.starter_ring2.other: Worn smooth by a thumb that never stopped waiting.

lore.starter_mainhand.other: A familiar weight against the dark, passed from one survivor to another.

lore.starter_offhand.other: Pilgrims slept in turns. This kept watch with those who could not.

lore.echo_ring.other: Hold it to your ear. The voices stop when they realize you are listening.

lore.greatstaff.other: The empty crown frames a star that no living astronomer remembers.

power.property.burning_stacks.descriptio.other: With Ashcleaver equipped, burning kills grant 5% faster attack windup and recovery per stack, up to 5 stacks. Stacks expire after 5 seconds without a burning kill.

power.property.summon_burst.description.other: When an allied summon expires, it bursts for 24 Decay damage in a 2.3m radius. Multiple copies do not multiply this effect.

power.rune.guard.description.other: Each successful dodge grants 15 barrier, up to the 200 barrier cap. Multiple copies do not multiply this effect.

power.evolution.serath.description.other: Direct skill hits that damage health heal you. Kills of burning foes can raise temporary flaming revenants, subject to corpse and summon limits.

power.evolution.orrun.description.other: Grants 5 percentage points of defense and 4 barrier on direct skill hits that damage health. At 5 stacks, the awakened wave becomes an igniting seismic strike.

power.awakening.dormant.description.other: Awakens after 1,000 burning kills while equipped. Then direct skill hits at 5 stacks can release a fire wave once per second.

power.awakening.awakened.description.other: Direct skill hits at 5 stacks release a fire wave, at most once per second. A permanent evolution can alter this power.

lore.pyrebound_treads.other: The condemned walked from the pyre. Every step remembered the fire.

lore.oathkeeper_reprisal.other: Each blow denied was a promise. Every promise would be returned.

lore.widows_last_echo.other: She stitched a second shadow into her gloves, so no arrow would travel alone.

power.property.pyre_trail.description.other: A moving dodge leaves three burning patches for 2 seconds. Each patch pulses for 6 Fire damage and applies Burning. Copies do not stack.

power.property.oath_reprisal.description.other: Enemy damage absorbed by your barrier stores up to 60 charge for 8 seconds. Your next melee hit releases it as Crush damage within 2.4m. Copies do not stack.

power.property.widow_echo.description.other: After dodging, your next projectile skill within 5 seconds fires a delayed Void echo at half its base damage. The echo cannot fork, chain, or trigger other hit powers. Copies do not stack.

source.pyrebound_treads.other: Found: clear the Road ambush in Act I; also Grey March Fracture final rooms.

source.oathkeeper_reprisal.other: Found: defeat the Covenant Warden in Act IV; also Shattered Spine Fracture final rooms.

source.widows_last_echo.other: Found: defeat Rootheart in Act II; also Verdant Maw Fracture final rooms.

lore.rotwake_signet.other: The physician sealed the quarantine with wax and a thorn. By morning, the thorn had flowered.

lore.mourning_choir.other: The names of the lost were carved into these pipes. Now the dead answer when you strike the first note.

lore.furnaceheart_cinch.other: A forgekeeper trapped the furnace's last breath behind an iron grate. It still waits for the bellows.

power.property.virulent_wake.description.other: When your Poisoned damage kills a foe, spread one Poisoned stack to up to 3 foes within 2.6m and sight. 3-second cooldown. Spread poison cannot spread again; the corpse remains. Copies do not stack.

power.property.rallying_chorus.descripti.other: A direct skill hit on a surviving foe calls up to 3 of your available summons within 6m and sight of it. Each strikes for 8 base Void damage. 3-second cooldown. These strikes cannot critically hit or trigger hit powers. Copies do not stack.

power.property.cinder_cycle.description.other: Using a skill costing at least 20 resource prepares one charge for 6 seconds. Your next free, resource-generating direct skill hit restores 12 extra resource. Arcanists instead Vent 12 extra Instability; Gravecallers harvest 12 extra Remains from a corpse. Charges and copies do not stack.

source.rotwake_signet.other: Found: secure Plague Village in Act II; also Verdant Maw Fracture room 1.

source.mourning_choir.other: Found: clear the Extraction Floor in Act III; also Verdant Maw Fracture room 2.

source.furnaceheart_cinch.other: Found: defeat the Furnace Spindle in Act III; also Cinder Reach Fracture final rooms.

lore.crown_unsworn.other: The judge broke his oath before the final sentence. The crown remembers the words he refused to speak.

lore.last_witness.other: When every name had been erased, one witness remained. Her vow became the weight around the executioner’s neck.

lore.stolen_hour.other: A thief stole one hour from a dying god. These greaves still outrun the debt.

power.property.unspoken_verdict.descript.other: Interrupting an enemy cast or warning with hard crowd control grants 40 barrier. 3-second cooldown. Resisted control and idle targets do not trigger it. Copies do not stack.

power.property.witness_vow.description.other: Hit the same surviving foe with 4 distinct direct skill actions, each within 4 seconds of the previous, to release 24 base Void damage. Changing targets resets the count. The burst cannot critically hit or trigger other hit powers. Copies do not stack.

power.property.borrowed_hour.description.other: Using an ultimate prepares 3 charges for 8 seconds. Your next 3 accepted non-ultimate skills with a cooldown have their assigned cooldown halved, with a minimum of 1 tick. Free skills without a cooldown do not spend charges. Copies do not stack.

source.crown_unsworn.other: Found: clear the Contract Hall in Act IV; also Shattered Spine Fracture room 2 and the final phase of Orrun Without an Oath.

source.last_witness.other: Found: secure Identity Memory in Act V; also Hollow Night Fracture room 2 and the final phase of The Thousand Memories of Serath.

source.stolen_hour.other: Found: defeat the Breach Heart in Act V; also Hollow Night Fracture final rooms and the final phase of The Shape That Remembers Nhal.
